campaign: Northeast Ohio Treasure Hunt — Tom Colosimo & Participating Business Demo
presentation_goal: Demonstrate one connected workflow that captures hunters, distributes traffic, verifies merchant visits, creates rewards and referrals, produces return business, retains participants and proves ROI.

modules.label: Hunter Passport
modules.title: Hunter Passport — Join Once, Keep Earning
modules.subtitle: Turn the first Treasure Hunt interaction into a customer relationship the merchants can keep serving.
modules.description: The Hunter Passport is the entry point for the entire system. A participant joins once, receives a digital Treasure Hunt identity, and carries the same relationship through merchant visits, stamps, points, rewards, referrals and post-hunt offers.
modules.hunter_action: Join the Hunt and activate the digital Hunter Passport.
modules.system_action: Create the participant relationship and connect future activity to one campaign identity.
modules.merchant_value: A business can recognize a Hunt visitor as a returning customer instead of seeing anonymous foot traffic.
modules.example_content: WELCOME HUNTER — Activate your Passport and receive 100 starter points. Use the same Passport at every participating business.
modules.success_signal: New hunter enrolled and ready for attributable activity.
bullets: One enrollment connects the full customer journey
Stores points, visit and reward progress
Creates the permissioned audience used by later modules
modules.why_tom: Tom gains a persistent participant base instead of losing the relationship when the clue or event ends.

modules.label: Explorer Trail
modules.title: 5-Stop Explorer Trail — Move Traffic Across Town
modules.subtitle: Give every hunter a clear reason to visit multiple participating businesses.
modules.description: The Explorer Trail turns the Hunt into a cross-business customer journey. Each verified participating-business stop earns a stamp. Completing all five stops unlocks a local reward, encouraging hunters to circulate through the merchant network instead of visiting only one clue location.
modules.hunter_action: Visit five participating businesses and collect one verified stamp at each stop.
modules.system_action: Track stop-by-stop progress and unlock the completion reward after the required visits.
modules.merchant_value: Merchants receive intentional traffic from a shared campaign rather than depending on whether a clue happens to point to them.
modules.example_content: EXPLORER TRAIL — 0/5 STOPS. Visit 5 participating businesses. Complete the trail to unlock your Explorer Reward.
modules.success_signal: Hunter completes multiple merchant visits across the network.
bullets: Five numbered merchant stops
Visible progress from 0/5 through completion
Completion reward drives the full route
modules.why_tom: The Hunt becomes a traffic-routing system for participating businesses, which strengthens the value of participation and sponsorship.

modules.label: Business Discovery
modules.title: Participating Business Discovery — Make Every Merchant Visible
modules.subtitle: Give each participating business its own reason to be discovered, visited and remembered.
modules.description: This module presents participating businesses as individual destinations inside the Hunt ecosystem. Each listing can show the merchant name, category, location, Hunt offer, participation role and next action without exposing or changing official clues.
modules.hunter_action: Choose the next participating business based on location, category, offer or Hunt activity.
modules.system_action: Surface relevant participating businesses and connect the hunter to the next visit opportunity.
modules.merchant_value: Every participating business gets a distinct campaign presence rather than being buried in a generic sponsor list.
modules.example_content: FEATURED HUNT STOP — Fieldview Acres Mercantile. Hunt participant perk: bonus Passport points after a verified visit. Open details for hours, location and Hunt offer.
modules.success_signal: Hunter discovers and selects a participating business to visit.
bullets: Merchant-specific information instead of duplicated card copy
Category, location and offer-based discovery
Creates sponsor value before, during and after clue releases
modules.why_tom: Tom can show merchants exactly how the system gives each business exposure and a measurable path to a visit.

modules.label: Clue Reward
modules.title: Clue Completion Reward — Reward the Visit, Not the Answer
modules.subtitle: Add a measurable reward around clue activity while keeping Tom's official Treasure Hunt completely separate.
modules.description: After an approved clue-related action or verified business visit, the hunter can unlock a merchant-funded reward. The module never changes the clue, reveals the answer or affects the odds of finding the treasure; it only rewards the commercial engagement around the Hunt.
modules.hunter_action: Complete the qualifying clue-related visit or approved activity.
modules.system_action: Issue the defined reward only after the qualifying action is verified.
modules.merchant_value: A merchant can attach a concrete benefit to Hunt engagement and measure how many rewards were triggered or redeemed.
modules.example_content: CLUE VISIT BONUS — Verified Hunt visit completed. Reward unlocked: 250 Passport points + participating-business bonus offer.
modules.success_signal: Verified activity produces a trackable reward event.
bullets: Official clue logic remains untouched
Reward can be points, a perk or a merchant offer
Reward issuance is attributable to campaign activity
modules.why_tom: Tom maintains control and integrity of the Hunt while Places Rewards adds measurable business value around it.

modules.label: Merchant Check-In
modules.title: Merchant Check-In — Prove the Foot Traffic
modules.subtitle: Convert a claimed visit into a verified participating-business interaction.
modules.description: At the business, the hunter is verified through the merchant or staff workflow. The check-in can issue the appropriate stamp or points and records that the Treasure Hunt produced an actual visit at that merchant.
modules.hunter_action: Present the Hunter Passport or QR at the participating business.
modules.system_action: Verify the visit, record the merchant and timestamp, then trigger the configured stamp, points or eligibility.
modules.merchant_value: The merchant gets evidence that the Hunt sent a real person through the door.
modules.example_content: MERCHANT CHECK-IN — Visit verified at participating location. +1 Explorer Trail stamp. +25 Passport points.
modules.success_signal: A merchant-level visit is recorded and attributed to the Hunt.
bullets: Fast staff or QR-assisted check-in
Triggers the correct next reward action
Produces merchant-level traffic data
modules.why_tom: This is the proof layer for merchant and sponsor conversations: not impressions, but verified visits.

modules.label: Local Prize
modules.title: Local Prize & Giveaway — Give Every Business a Win Moment
modules.subtitle: Create more winners, more sponsor inventory and more reasons to stay engaged between major clues.
modules.description: A participating business can contribute a prize, experience, gift card or special reward. Eligibility can be tied to a verified visit, Explorer Trail milestone or another approved campaign action, giving merchants their own promotional moment without altering the grand treasure.
modules.hunter_action: Complete the qualifying visit or milestone to enter or unlock the local prize.
modules.system_action: Record eligibility, prize inventory and redemption separately from the main Treasure Hunt.
modules.merchant_value: The merchant gets a branded promotional moment and can see how many hunters engaged with the prize.
modules.example_content: LOCAL PRIZE SPOTLIGHT — Complete this stop to qualify for a $25 local-business gift card drawing. One verified entry per hunter.
modules.success_signal: A participating business receives measurable engagement around its own prize.
bullets: Merchant-funded prize or experience
Eligibility tied to real campaign activity
Separate from the grand treasure and official Hunt odds
modules.why_tom: Tom can offer sponsors more than logo placement: each business can own a measurable activation inside the Hunt.

modules.label: Referral
modules.title: Bring Another Hunter — Let Participants Grow the Hunt
modules.subtitle: Turn enthusiastic hunters into a measurable acquisition channel.
modules.description: Every hunter receives a unique referral path. When a new participant joins through that path and completes the qualifying action, Places Rewards can attribute the referral and reward the inviter, the new hunter or both.
modules.hunter_action: Share the personal Hunt invitation with a friend or family member.
modules.system_action: Attribute the new signup to the referring hunter and apply the configured referral reward after qualification.
modules.merchant_value: More participants enter the same merchant network without every new customer requiring additional paid advertising.
modules.example_content: BRING ANOTHER HUNTER — Your friend gets 50 welcome points. You get 100 points after their first points-earning purchase.
modules.success_signal: A new hunter joins through an attributable participant referral.
bullets: Unique referral attribution
Configurable two-sided rewards
Organic participant growth that can be measured
modules.why_tom: The existing community helps grow the next Hunt and the participating-business customer pool.

modules.label: Hunter VIP
modules.title: Hunter VIP — Reward the People Who Support Local Most
modules.subtitle: Recognize the hunters who repeatedly visit, buy, refer and participate.
modules.description: The VIP tier gives the most active participants a visible level to work toward. Qualification can use accumulated points and activity, while benefits can include premium merchant offers, early access, special experiences or next-Hunt privileges.
modules.hunter_action: Keep earning points and completing qualifying local-business activity.
modules.system_action: Track progress toward the VIP threshold and unlock the configured benefits when earned.
modules.merchant_value: Merchants can identify and serve the highest-engagement local customers differently from one-time visitors.
modules.example_content: HUNTER VIP — 1,850 / 2,500 points. Unlock at 2,500: premium merchant perks, early Hunt previews and VIP local experiences.
modules.success_signal: Highly engaged hunters progress into a reusable VIP audience segment.
bullets: Clear progression threshold
Premium benefits for repeat local support
Reusable high-value segment for future promotions
modules.why_tom: The Hunt becomes a long-term community membership engine, not just a winner-takes-all event.

modules.label: Mystery Bonus
modules.title: Mystery Bonus Scratch & Win — Add Instant Excitement
modules.subtitle: Give merchants an instant-win mechanic that is fun, controllable and completely separate from the real treasure.
modules.description: A qualifying visit can issue a digital scratch opportunity. The prize pool can contain merchant perks, bonus points, discounts or no-win outcomes according to the configured campaign rules and inventory.
modules.hunter_action: Scratch the digital Mystery Bonus after completing the qualifying activity.
modules.system_action: Resolve the configured outcome, record it and issue any associated reward.
modules.merchant_value: A business gets an additional engagement mechanic that can drive redemption and repeat visits.
modules.example_content: MYSTERY BONUS — Scratch now. Possible rewards: 100 bonus points, free add-on, 10% off next visit, or another merchant-defined surprise.
modules.success_signal: Hunter interacts with a controlled gamification event and, when applicable, redeems a merchant reward.
bullets: Configurable win rate and prize inventory
Instant reward moment after a visit
No effect on official clues or treasure odds
modules.why_tom: It keeps the Hunt exciting between clue releases while creating additional sponsor inventory.

modules.label: Comeback Offer
modules.title: Hunter Comeback Offer — Turn the First Visit Into the Second
modules.subtitle: Use the Hunt visit as the beginning of revenue, not the end of the interaction.
modules.description: After the initial campaign visit, the hunter receives a time-bounded merchant offer designed to trigger a second purchase. The demo uses $5 off $25, while each business can configure the value and minimum spend that fits its economics.
modules.hunter_action: Return to the participating business and redeem the comeback offer before expiration.
modules.system_action: Validate the voucher, enforce usage rules and record the redemption as post-Hunt activity.
modules.merchant_value: The business gets a direct mechanism for converting campaign foot traffic into a repeat transaction.
modules.example_content: HUNTER COMEBACK — $5 OFF $25. Thank you for exploring with us. Return within 14 days and use this one-time offer on your next qualifying purchase.
modules.success_signal: A first-time Hunt visitor completes a measurable second transaction.
bullets: Time-limited second-visit incentive
Minimum-spend protection
Redemption can be attributed to Hunt acquisition
modules.why_tom: This is the point where merchant participation begins producing measurable post-event revenue behavior.

modules.label: Post-Hunt Retention
modules.title: Post-Hunt Retention — Keep the Customer Relationship Alive
modules.subtitle: Automatically continue the relationship after the final clue and winner announcement.
modules.description: Participants can be segmented by what they actually did: completed the trail, almost completed it, became inactive, earned VIP progress, referred friends or redeemed offers. Follow-up can then match the participant's behavior instead of sending one generic message to everyone.
modules.hunter_action: Receive the next relevant message or offer based on actual Hunt activity.
modules.system_action: Segment participant behavior and prepare the appropriate thank-you, reminder, comeback, VIP or next-Hunt communication.
modules.merchant_value: Participating businesses continue receiving value from the audience after the event team has moved on.
modules.example_content: YOU'RE 1 STOP AWAY — Your Explorer Trail is almost complete. Finish your final participating-business visit this week and unlock your completion reward.
modules.success_signal: Dormant or unfinished participants re-engage after the main Hunt activity.
bullets: Behavior-based follow-up instead of generic blasts
Different journeys for active, inactive and near-complete hunters
Builds early demand for the next Hunt
modules.why_tom: Retention work continues without Tom manually following up with every participant.

modules.label: Analytics & ROI
modules.title: Organizer & Merchant ROI — Prove What the Hunt Produced
modules.subtitle: End the workflow with evidence that helps Tom renew sponsors, improve the next Hunt and sell participation.
modules.description: The final module consolidates enrollments, merchant visits, stamp progress, reward events, referrals, voucher redemptions and post-Hunt returns into an organizer and merchant performance view. It turns activity into a sponsor-ready story rather than relying only on social reach or anecdotal traffic.
modules.hunter_action: No additional hunter action; this module measures the journey already completed.
modules.system_action: Aggregate attributable campaign activity into organizer- and merchant-level performance metrics.
modules.merchant_value: Each participating business can see the activity the campaign produced for it and which mechanisms drove return behavior.
modules.example_content: HUNT IMPACT — Hunters enrolled • verified merchant visits • Explorer Trail completions • referrals • rewards redeemed • comeback redemptions • repeat-visit rate. Demo figures remain illustrative until live campaign data exists.
modules.success_signal: Tom can demonstrate measurable value and use the evidence to improve and renew the next campaign.
bullets: Complete funnel from enrollment to repeat visit
Merchant-level and campaign-level performance
Evidence for sponsor renewal and next-Hunt planning
modules.why_tom: This is the subscription closer because Places Rewards provides the measurement layer the event can reuse every year.
